contentText: Starting in September, legendary singer Celine Dion will perform 16 concerts in Paris. This will be Dion’s first performances after a lengthy break prompted by a rare health condition. As fans flock from overseas, ticket sales, hotels and restaurants could bring hundreds of millions of euros to the French capital. Amid the frenzied anticipation, authorities are warning people to watch out for scams. Gabrielle Nadler reports.
